scripts.build:dev: npx @cloudflare/next-on-pages && find .vercel/output/static/_worker.js -type f -name '*.js' -exec sed -i 's/"async_hooks"/"node:async_hooks"/g' {} + && find .vercel/output/static/_worker.js -type f -name '*.js' -exec sed -i "s/'async_hooks'/'node:async_hooks'/g" {} +
scripts.build:prod: npx @cloudflare/next-on-pages && find .vercel/output/static/_worker.js -type f -name '*.js' -exec sed -i 's/"async_hooks"/"node:async_hooks"/g' {} + && find .vercel/output/static/_worker.js -type f -name '*.js' -exec sed -i "s/'async_hooks'/'node:async_hooks'/g" {} +
scripts.deploy:dev: cd api-worker && npx wrangler deploy --config wrangler.toml && cd .. && npm run build:dev && CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID=ef964688891b9260ac3e9a712c69cd74 npx wrangler pages deploy .vercel/output/static --project-name dev-farha
scripts.deploy:prod: cd api-worker && npx wrangler deploy --config wrangler.prod.toml && cd .. && npm run build:prod && CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID=ef964688891b9260ac3e9a712c69cd74 npx wrangler pages deploy .vercel/output/static --project-name farha
scripts.db:init-local: cd api-worker && npx wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file=../schema.sql
scripts.db:init-dev: cd api-worker && npx wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --file=../schema.sql --config wrangler.toml
scripts.db:init-prod: cd api-worker && npx wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --file=../schema.sql --config wrangler.prod.toml
